name: reprolens
description: Turn vague bug reports into visual evidence and regression tests.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @reprolens/api" "npm run dev --workspace @reprolens/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @reprolens/api && npm run build --workspace @reprolens/web
scripts.check: npm run test && npm run build
